tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: can_advisor
    description: "Canonical advisor entity. One row per advisor enriched with team info and aggregate book metrics (client count, account count, total AUM). Draws from res_advisor_book, res_client_advisor, res_client_account, and res_account_value."
    config:
      domain: 'Advisor'
    columns:
      - name: canonical_advisor_id
        description: "Surrogate key for this canonical row"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "FSC advisor identifier (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: advisor_name
        description: "Resolved advisor full name"
      - name: first_name
        description: "Advisor first name"
      - name: last_name
        description: "Advisor last name"
      - name: email
        description: "Resolved advisor email"
      - name: role
        description: "Advisor role: Lead Advisor, Senior Advisor, etc."
      - name: crd_number
        description: "FINRA Central Registration Depository number"
      - name: rep_code
        description: "Resolved rep code (FSC > Custodian)"
      - name: branch
        description: "Resolved branch name"
      - name: custodian_code
        description: "Custodian identifier linked through rep code"
      - name: is_active
        description: "Whether the advisor is currently active"
      - name: hire_date
        description: "Advisor hire date"
      - name: termination_date
        description: "Advisor termination date, NULL if active"
      - name: team_id
        description: "Team identifier"
      - name: team_name
        description: "Team display name"
      - name: region
        description: "Team region"
      - name: client_count
        description: "Number of active clients assigned to this advisor"
      - name: account_count
        description: "Number of active accounts across all clients"
      - name: total_aum
        description: "Total assets under management across all client accounts"
      - name: advisor_match_status
        description: "Cross-system match quality: FSC_CUST_MATCHED, FSC_ONLY"
